sentences.text:
Bench: J.K. Maheshwari, Rajesh Bindal
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Original Jurisdiction
 Transfer Petition (Criminal) No. 366 Of 2024
 Sweta Kumari @ Sonam & Ors. Petit
 Versus
 Vidyawati Devi Respo
 O R D E R

1) In the present case, transfer of a private criminal complaint No. 10488 of 2023 titled as Vidyawati Devi v. Sweta Kumari @ Sonam & Ors. filed by the mother-in-law against the petitioner (daughter-in-law) and her parents at Dhanbad, Jharkhand, has been prayed for to Ballia, Uttar Pradesh, inter alia, contending that three cases filed by petitioner previous to the private complaint by the mother-in-law, at Ballia, are pending.

entities.text: Vidyawati Devi v. Sweta Kumari @ Sonam & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2) Despite service of notice on the respondent, no one has entered appearance on her behalf.

However, TRANSFER PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO. 366 OF 2024 vide order dated 15.10.2024,
awaiting representation of the respondent, the matter was adjourned.
Even today, there is no one present on behalf of the respondent to oppose the prayer as made in the transfer petition.

3) Having considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and taking note of the fact that three cases i.e., (i) under section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, (ii) under section 498A with other sections of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, and (iii) under section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, have been filed by the petitioner prior to the filing of the private complaint which is sought to be transferred and in those cases, the respondent is appearing and attending the proceedings, we deem it appropriate to allow this transfer petition.
4) Accordingly, Criminal Complaint No. 10488 of 2023 titled as Vidyawati Devi v. Sweta Kumari @
Sonam & Ors. under Sections 323/341/147/148/379 and 448 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860,
pending before TRANSFER PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO. 366 OF 2024 the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad, Jharkhand, is directed to be transferred to the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, District Court of Ballia, Uttar Pradesh, who may either try the same himself or entrust Sweta Kumari @ Sonam vs Vidyawati Devi on 6 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132001923/
1 the same to the court of competent jurisdiction keeping in view the fact, where other cases are pending.
5) On asking, it is on the discretion of the transferee Court to allow the presence of the respondent virtually until necessarily required.
6) On intimation by e-mail, the records of the case be transferred to the transferee Court without any delay and immediate compliance be made.
7) The transfer petition is, accordingly, allowed.
